title: Rubella Stand-Up
summary: Item Seven: Resident Comments. The podium is a laundry-room intercom. Madelyn put her on the list. Folding chairs creak; they do not clap. Spoken Voice bed, not a musical.
visualArc: Podium lock → detergent relic → heckle wide (she does not turn) → land with duplicate forms.

segments.label: A — Podium Lock
segments.onScreen: Rubella behind the honey-oak table, unused brass mic, half-empty mug, fluorescent hallway bleed, empty first row, resignation face.
segments.lyrics:
Good evening. I'm Rubella. Item Seven. Resident comments.
I didn't put my name on the list. The list put my name on me.
Item Five was the ping-pong table. They tabled it.
Item Four was the fire. They tabled that too.
I filed a ticket. The ticket hummed back.
My pension was in a folder called final_final_2.
I gave the eulogy. Mostly the file name.
segments.musicCue: Dry raspy Voice bed, slight hallway slap, fluorescent tick. No music. Mug set down like evidence.

segments.label: B — Detergent Relic
segments.onScreen: Mid-set, unlabeled bottle in the off-hand like a sacred object, lace, chairs in soft focus.
segments.lyrics:
The elevator just tried to negotiate. I told it I already pay rent.
It said, "Four." I said, "Six." "Four." "Three."
Stop. Go back. You were doing well.
I don't need a hero. I need the detergent that still works.
Number forty-seven hums. Mine finishes a cycle.
They wrote me up for the quiet.
segments.musicCue: Voice bed continues. One chair creak on "well," peggy-babcock-second sibling. No chirp flock.

segments.label: C — Heckle Wide
segments.onScreen: Rubella does not turn. Lillith one chair in the back row, mouth open one frame. Clipboard silhouette in the last chair.
segments.lyrics:
RUBELLA: That tube is pinker than the other one. I logged it as a fire hazard.
LILLITH (off-mic): It's not a fire hazard. It's ambient lighting with ambition.
RUBELLA: That's my roommate. I'll file that under lighting.
segments.musicCue: Rubella logs the pink tube first, still not turning. Lillith heckle once, bright, too helpful, off-mic. Rubella does not look at her. No second heckle.

segments.label: D — Land
segments.onScreen: Two identical forms in her hand. Mug empty. Mic still unused in spirit. Chairs have crept one inch back.
segments.lyrics:
If the floor is on fire again, I'm charging it for emotional damages.
I already have the form. The duplicate is dated next Thursday.
Madelyn sent a memo. "Item Four remains tabled."
The table is on fire.
That's my time. The chairs can creak.
I'm waiting for a dryer that does not summon anything.
segments.musicCue: Chair creak in unison on the land. Fluorescent tick. End. No sitcom whoops.
